title: Songs and dances she says she introduced
summary: She says she introduced "Some Day, Sweetheart" and "A Good Man Is Hard to Find" in Chicago, and "St. Louis Blues" and the Black Bottom in England.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
